SEBI revises FPI fees and mutual fund borrowing rules

The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has announced changes to its fee structure for Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs), shifting from a US dollar-based system to a rupee-based one. Additionally, SEBI has eased borrowing rules for mutual funds. These measures aim to streamline processes and potentially reduce costs for investors.
